title: Retail Loan Eligibility & Debt-to-Income Limits Policy
content: Retail Loan Eligibility Guidelines: All personal and retail loan applicants must undergo credit risk assessment and debt-to-income (DTI) evaluation. Applicants with existing DTI below 40% qualify for standard prime rates starting at 10.5% per annum. Applicants with DTI between 40% and 50% require additional income verification and manager review. Any loan application that results in a projected DTI exceeding 50% is classified as High Risk and must not be approved without executive committee exception. Applicants must have fully verified KYC status. Minimum tenure is 6 months and maximum tenure is 84 months.

passages.text: Retail loan eligibility requires DTI below 40% for standard prime rates (10.5% p.a.). Projected DTI between 40% and 50% requires manager review. Projected DTI exceeding 50% is classified as High Risk and is subject to committee exception.
Mandatory loan criteria: Applicant must hold verified KYC status, have at least 6 months of verifiable employment history, and requested tenure must be between 6 and 84 months.
